name: initThrowsIllegalArgumentExceptionOnEmptyPattern
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because patternMatcher.lookingAt() fails on an empty string since the formatPattern regex requires at least one matching token.

name: initThrowsIllegalArgumentExceptionOnInvalidPatternToken
input: pattern = "yyyy-MM-dd XXX", timeZone = TimeZone.getDefault(), locale = Locale.getDefault()
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because 'XXX' does not fully match the formatPattern and patternMatcher.regionStart() != patternMatcher.regionEnd(), causing the unparsed tail check to fail.

name: initSuccessfullyInitializesStandardPattern
expected: Successfully initializes strategies, parsePattern, and thisYear without throwing any exceptions for a valid standard date pattern.

name: initInitializesComplexPatternWithMultipleStrategies
input: pattern = "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS Z", timeZone = TimeZone.getDefault(), locale = Locale.getDefault()
expected: Successfully compiles regex, populates strategy collector, and handles literal text segments like 'T'.

name: initHandlesSingleCharacterPatternToken
expected: Successfully initializes with a single strategy element in collector and sets up corresponding parsePattern.

name: initHandlesRepeatedCharactersStrategyToken
expected: Successfully handles repeated characters matching formatPattern (e.g., 'yyyy' grouped together into one field/strategy).

name: initHandlesLiteralStringWithQuotes
input: pattern = "yyyy-MM-dd 'at' HH:mm:ss", timeZone = TimeZone.getDefault(), locale = Locale.getDefault()
expected: Successfully parses quoted literal string segments via the formatPattern regex matching quoted clauses ('[^']++(...)++').

name: initSetsUpThisYearAccordingToTimeZoneAndLocale
expected: Successfully computes thisYear using Calendar.getInstance(timeZone, locale).

name: initInitializesNameValuesConcurrentMap
input: pattern = "MMM EEE", timeZone = TimeZone.getDefault(), locale = Locale.US
expected: Initializes nameValues as an empty ConcurrentHashMap ready to cache localized display names.

name: initThrowsIllegalArgumentExceptionWhenPatternStartsLocallyInvalid
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because patternMatcher.lookingAt() fails immediately on the leading invalid character '@'.

name: initHandlesAllSupportedCalendarFieldsCombined
input: pattern = "G y M d H m s S E a Z", timeZone = TimeZone.getDefault(), locale = Locale.getDefault()
expected: Successfully sequences multiple distinct strategy types and builds a combined regular expression.

name: initHandlesEscapedSingleQuoteLiteral
expected: Successfully parses doubled single quotes ('') as a literal string pattern token.
